description: Use this when the user wants a restaurant menu saved to their ChefBear account from photos they provide: to keep it, get it as a structured menu in their language, share it, or open it in the ChefBear app. Creates a private ChefBear menu from 1 to 5 menu photos, given as uploaded files where the app supports file inputs (files) or as public https:// image links (photoUrls). Uses one recognition from the user's ChefBear allowance, so don't call it just to answer a question about a photo already in the conversation unless the user wants it saved. Returns a jobId; recognition usually takes 20 to 60 seconds, then get_import_status returns the menuId. Does not create images or public links.

language.description: Language for dish names and descriptions: en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, es, vi, ko or ja (zh, zh-TW and similar forms also work). When omitted, ChefBear uses the conversation's language if the app reports one of these, else en.

photoUrls.description: Public https:// links to the menu photos the user provided (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC or AVIF, up to 15 MB each).

requestId.description: A new unique ID for this import, such as a UUID. Repeating the same requestId with the same photos returns the same job instead of importing twice.

name: import_menu
title: Import menu photos
